title: feat(alerts): Linear as an alert destination

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Delivery, idempotency and the reopen window are pinned by a fake-port suite plus a PGlite end-to-end run; the two warnings are in the comment answer and the team picker. 2 warnings −2 · tests covered · risk medium · 2/2 new units observable Adds Linear as an alert destination: a GraphQL transport keeping one issue per rule and group, an `alert_linear_issues` thread table, and the v2 API, alchemy resource and dialog surface. The delivery path is sound; a refused comment is recorded as sent, and the team picker can hold a stale team. - `linearTransport` opens one issue per rule and group, comments, and reopens within 24h - `LinearIssueTracker` runs GraphQL with the org's token and owns `alert_linear_issues` - Changing a destination's team deletes that destination's threads in the same transaction - v2 API, alchemy `Maple.AlertDestination` and the destination dialog accept `linear`/`team_id` ### Before merge - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261028190143_alert_linear_issues/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/7b98a86258aaf912f690d8e403af5e2d67fbdea6/packages/db/drizzle/20261028190143_alert_linear_issues/migration.sql) - [ ] **Manual** · Merge #1939 (`feat/linear-connection`) first: this branch is stacked on it and does not build alone ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · A comment Linear refuses is recorded as delivered correctness · [`packages/backend/src/services/alerts/LinearIssueTracker.ts:91`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/7b98a86258aaf912f690d8e403af5e2d67fbdea6/packages/backend/src/services/alerts/LinearIssueTracker.ts#L91) `request` answers `null` for a `FORBIDDEN` whenever `missingIsNull` is set, and `comment` sets it (`linear.ts:201`) only to absorb its own duplicate answer. `trigger` (`linear.ts:375`, `linear.ts:383`) discards that null and `resolve` (`linear.ts:422`) reads it as a retried comment, so a comment Linear refused is reported as "Commented on Linear issue ENG-7" and the delivery counts as sent; the new PGlite suite exercises `FORBIDDEN` on `MapleComment` without `missingIsNull` (`AlertsService.linear.test.ts:284`), where it correctly fails, and never with it. ``` Check `forbidden` before the `missingIsNull` branch and fail `AlertDeliveryTargetMissingError` there, keeping only `isNotFound` under `missingIsNull`, with a separate option for `fetchIssue`/`fetchTeam` to treat a hidden entity as gone. ```
🟠 Warning · F2 · Team picker keeps a linearTeamId it no longer lists correctness · [`apps/web/src/page/alerts/destination/linear-fields.ts:187-190`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/7b98a86258aaf912f690d8e403af5e2d67fbdea6/apps/web/src/page/alerts/destination/linear-fields.ts#L187-L190) When the fetched teams no longer contain `form.linearTeamId` (the team was archived in Linear, or Linear was reconnected to another workspace, which `statusAnswered` already anticipates) `teamName` returns `""` and `teamsAnswered` returns without touching the form. `teamField` then renders the "Pick a team" placeholder while `isFormReady` (`dialog.ts:271`) still passes, so Save posts a `team_id` the server rejects with "That team is not in the connected Linear workspace" and nothing on screen connects the error to the picker. ``` When the teams read succeeded and none matches `form.linearTeamId`, return `form: { linearTeamId: "", linearTeamName: "" }` so the picker and `isFormReady` agree, as `reset` does for a fresh form. ```

> [!WARNING]
> **A comment Linear refuses is recorded as delivered**
>
> <sub>F1 · Warning · correctness</sub>

`request` answers `null` for a `FORBIDDEN` whenever `missingIsNull` is set, and `comment` sets it (`linear.ts:201`) only to absorb its own duplicate answer. `trigger` (`linear.ts:375`, `linear.ts:383`) discards that null and `resolve` (`linear.ts:422`) reads it as a retried comment, so a comment Linear refused is reported as "Commented on Linear issue ENG-7" and the delivery counts as sent; the new PGlite suite exercises `FORBIDDEN` on `MapleComment` without `missingIsNull` (`AlertsService.linear.test.ts:284`), where it correctly fails, and never with it.

```
Check `forbidden` before the `missingIsNull` branch and fail `AlertDeliveryTargetMissingError` there, keeping only `isNotFound` under `missingIsNull`, with a separate option for `fetchIssue`/`fetchTeam` to treat a hidden entity as gone.
```

> [!WARNING]
> **Team picker keeps a `linearTeamId` it no longer lists**
>
> <sub>F2 · Warning · correctness</sub>

When the fetched teams no longer contain `form.linearTeamId` (the team was archived in Linear, or Linear was reconnected to another workspace, which `statusAnswered` already anticipates) `teamName` returns `""` and `teamsAnswered` returns without touching the form. `teamField` then renders the "Pick a team" placeholder while `isFormReady` (`dialog.ts:271`) still passes, so Save posts a `team_id` the server rejects with "That team is not in the connected Linear workspace" and nothing on screen connects the error to the picker.

```
When the teams read succeeded and none matches `form.linearTeamId`, return `form: { linearTeamId: "", linearTeamName: "" }` so the picker and `isFormReady` agree, as `reset` does for a fresh form.
```
